commands.summary: Backend build passed after adding the push_send capability, the provider-neutral push module (contracts, redaction profiles, ntfy default transport, adapter), and registering the push adapter behind pushConfigured() in server.ts.

12 push tests passed: ntfy defaults + disabled-by-default posture, lock-screen-safe default never emits caller content, full-profile control-char/header-injection stripping + length clamp, fallback-to-safe on empty/unknown profile, ref sanitization, send success through injected transport, disabled-when-unconfigured, provider-failure mapped to a caller-safe retryable error, and registry selection by the push_send capability.
Full Electron validation passed (backend node --test across all *.test.js + renderer vitest), including the new push suite; no regression from the server.ts adapter registration.
RepoPact plus ForgeLink local validation passed for the 019 criteria-state update, docs, evidence, and CHANGELOG.

environment.process_note: Foundation slice for work item 019. Satisfies PUSH-001 (provider-neutral push contracts incl. the optional signed action-response shape), PUSH-002 (ntfy provider strategy documented for the local-first boundary), and PUSH-004 (lock-screen-safe-default redaction profiles; full content only when explicitly selected). Push is notification-only and disabled by default. No secrets are stored or logged in this slice (PUSH-003 credential/device-token storage is deferred); no push action authority exists (PUSH-005 deferred). PUSH-007 remains pending: delivery/redaction/missing-creds/provider-outage are tested, but stale-token, duplicate-action-tap, and diagnostics-exclusion tests depend on the deferred storage/actions/diagnostics slices. Default ntfy transport live verification is deferred; all relied-on logic is unit-tested with an injected transport. No effect on work items 011 or 030.
